request: Build a small Jac web app for a library desk. A librarian adds books with a number of available copies and adds members. A member can borrow a book while copies are available and return it later; the desk shows each member's current loans and each book's remaining copies. Keep the loan rules in a reusable service.
acceptance: Borrowing decreases the book's available copies by one; borrowing with no copies left is rejected.
Returning a book increases its available copies by one; returning a book that is not on loan to that member is rejected.
A member's current loans list only books not yet returned.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements paraphrased in English from the repository README/description; no code copied.
